title: 第17章 天仙巅峰仿制九转大还丹第18章 竹节山七狮九灵元圣
slug: 西游开局获得太白金星传承
lines: 所以说，结交这两位，还是有那么一丝可能见到女娲的。
起码比他证道混元大罗要简单的多。
“现在距离这个还太远，以后再说吧。”
叶云心中自语，当前目标，还是将无量剑胎提升到后天功德至宝，再考虑其他。
随后，没过多长时间，有小妖来报，说是大铁锅准备好了。
叶云立刻将无量剑胎收入体内，身形一动，瞬间来到洞府外。
只见一口大铁锅架在那里，看起来有些老旧，不过还是完整的，叶云也就不挑了。
让小妖们退下后，叶云便开始取出天材地宝，按照其中的一些搭配，开始炼丹。
凭借他基础的炼丹水平，一开始使用铁锅炼丹时，的确是难度拉满。
不仅失败多次，甚至就算成功了，炼制出来的丹药也是质量参差不齐。
不过好在叶云每次炼丹，都会获得进度点，来提升丹道真解的进度。
就这样，一晃两个月时间过去。
在叶云坚持不懈的努力下，终于将丹道真解的进度提升到了大成的层次。
此刻。
叶云站在铁锅面前，神色平静，手上动作行云流水。
一套下来，给人感觉不像是在炼丹，简直如同艺术一般，赏心悦目。
没多久，铁锅之中便有浓郁的丹药香气散发出来，让人闻之全身舒畅。
将盖子打开，映入眼帘的是，正是一枚枚丹药，圆润剔透，丹纹环绕。
“不错，这一锅元灵丹很完美，不愧是大成层次的丹道真解水平。”
叶云满意的点了点头。
炼丹两个月，终于炼制出对他有用的丹药了，这下，就能服用丹药来进行苦修了。
至于他之前炼制的丹药，都被他作为奖励赐给了手下的群妖们。
这些丹药对天仙境的叶云来说没什么作用，但对这些妖怪们，可是从未见过的好东西。
自然一个个感恩戴德，同时更卖力的干活了。
“试试效果。”
叶云没有犹豫，立刻取出一枚元灵丹服用。
元灵丹，这是丹道真解里记录的一种品质很不错的灵丹。
不仅将天材地宝转化为充足且纯净的灵气，而且吸收速度也会提升很多。
随着丹药入体，叶云一边炼化，一边运转太白剑经吸收。
片刻时间，丹药炼化完毕，叶云看了一下太白剑经的进度。
比之前提升了一百多点。
“一枚元灵丹提升一百多进度点，对比天材地宝，果然要划算很多。”
同样提升一百多进度点，消耗的天材地宝就要好几株。
而这好几株天材地宝，足够炼制很多枚元灵丹了。
总体算下来，比直接炼化天材地宝，性价比要高很多。
而且元灵丹还不是丹道真解里品质最高的灵丹。
其中有一种名为“太虚还丹”
，效果更强。
据说是仿制太上老君的九转大还丹而成的。
九转大还丹，虽然不如九转金丹名气大，但在仙丹也是很有名的。
要知道，天蓬元帅曾在下界之时，就是因为服用了九转大还丹，才有了得道飞升的机会。

Therefore, if you make friends with these two people, there is still a slight possibility of meeting Nuwa.
At least it's much simpler than him realizing Hunyuan Da Luo.
"It's too far away from this now, let's talk about it later."
Ye Yun said to himself that the current goal is to upgrade the Infinite Sword Embryo to the treasure of acquired merit, and then consider other things.
Then, not long after, a little demon came to report that the big iron pot was ready.
Ye Yun immediately put the Infinite Sword Embryo into his body, and with a movement of his body, he arrived outside the cave in an instant.
I saw a big iron pot standing there. It looked a little old, but it was still complete, so Ye Yun didn't pick it.
After asking the little demons to retreat, Ye Yun began to take out the treasures of heaven and earth, and began to refine elixirs according to some of the combinations.
With his basic level of alchemy, it was really difficult to use the iron pot to make alchemy at the beginning.
Not only did it fail many times, but even if it succeeded, the quality of the elixirs produced varied.
Fortunately, every time Ye Yun refines elixirs, he will receive progress points to improve the progress of the true solution to the alchemy.
…
In this way, two months passed in a flash.
With Ye Yun's unremitting efforts, he finally raised the progress of the true solution of Alchemy to the level of Dacheng.
[True Interpretation of Alchemy (Dacheng 1,100,000)]
at this moment.
Ye Yun stood in front of the iron pot with a calm expression and smooth movements on his hands.
Once you put it together, it doesn't feel like you are refining elixirs, it feels like art, and it is pleasing to the eye.
Not long after, a rich aroma of elixir emanated from the iron pot, making people feel comfortable all over.
Opening the lid, what you see is a pill, round and clear, surrounded by pill patterns.
"Yes, this pot of Yuanling Dan is perfect. It is worthy of the Dacheng level of true elixir knowledge."
Ye Yun nodded with satisfaction.
After two months of refining elixirs, he finally made an elixir that was useful to him. Now, he could take the elixir to perform ascetic cultivation.
As for the elixirs he had refined before, he gave them to his demons as rewards.
These pills have no effect on Ye Yun in the Heavenly Immortal Realm, but for these monsters, they are something that has never been seen before.
Naturally, everyone was grateful and worked harder at the same time.
"Try the effect."
Ye Yun did not hesitate and immediately took out a Yuanling Pill and took it.
Yuan Ling Dan, this is a very good quality elixir recorded in the True Explanation of Alchemy.
Not only will the treasures of heaven and earth be converted into sufficient and pure spiritual energy, but the absorption speed will also be greatly increased.
As the elixir entered his body, Ye Yun was refining it while running the Taibai Sword Sutra to absorb it.
After a while, the elixir was refined, and Ye Yun took a look at the progress of the Taibai Sword Sutra.
It has improved by more than a hundred points than before.
"A Yuanling Pill increases the progress by more than 100 points. Compared with the treasures of heaven and earth, it is indeed much more cost-effective."
To increase the progress point by more than 100 points, it will consume several natural and earthly treasures.
And these several heavenly materials and earthly treasures are enough to refine many Yuanling Pills.
Overall, it is much more cost-effective than directly refining heavenly materials and earthly treasures.
Moreover, the Yuanling Pill is not the highest quality elixir in the True Solution to Alchemy.
Among them is one called "Taixu Huandan"
, the effect is stronger.
It is said to be an imitation of Taishang Laojun's Nine-turn Great Returning Pill.
Although the Nine-turn Great Return Pill is not as famous as the Nine-turn Golden Pill, it is also very famous among elixirs.
You must know that when Marshal Tianpeng was in the lower realm, it was because he took the Nine Transformations Great Return Pill that he had the chance to ascend.
